desc: Retrieve Seagate Host-Initiated Telemetry in either hex-dump (default) or binary format
r: nvme-seagate-get-host-tele - Retrieve Seagate Host-Initiated Telemetry in either hex-dump (default) or binary format

This will only work on Seagate devices supporting this feature. Not all commands work across all product families.

The <device> parameter is mandatory and may be either an NVMe character device (ex: /dev/nvme0) or an block device (ex: /dev/nvme0n1).

<dl><dt data-o="">-n <NUM>, --namespace-id=<NUM></dt><dd>desired namespace</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-i <NUM>, --log_specific=<NUM></dt><dd>1 - controller shall capture Data representing the internal state of the controller at the time the command is processed. 0 - controller shall not update the Telemetry Host Initiated Data.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-b, --raw-binary</dt><dd>output in raw format</dd></dl>

Get the host initiated telemetry log in hexdump or binary format for the specified device.

# nvme seagate get-host-tele /dev/nvme0
